routes.name: The Lindsey Ridings
routes.sub: A loop through Lindsey from Torksey by Lincoln, Grimsby, the Humber and Scunthorpe to Gainsborough

routes.name: Boroughs of Leicester and Stamford plus Holland
routes.sub: Leicester to Wainfleet by Rutland Water, Stamford, the Welland and the Wash

routes.name: Lindsey South and North Riding Coastal
routes.sub: Wainfleet to Barton-upon-Humber along the Lincolnshire coast and the Humber bank

routes.name: Skegness route
routes.sub: Newark to Skegness by Lincoln, the Witham and Woodhall Spa, keeping to the low ground

routes.name: Aire variant
routes.sub: Leeds to Hull by the Aire, Howden and the north bank of the Humber

routes.name: Humber Bridge link
routes.sub: Barton-upon-Humber over the Humber Bridge to Hessle, for Hull

routes.name: Don variant
routes.sub: Sheffield to Goole down the Don by Rotherham, Mexborough, Doncaster and Thorne

routes.name: Beverley route
routes.sub: Hull to York by Beverley, the Hudson Way and Pocklington, the direct line between the two cities

routes.name: Wolds route
routes.sub: Pocklington to Driffield over the Wolds

routes.name: Bridlington route
routes.sub: Beverley to Bridlington up the flat Hull valley by Driffield

routes.name: Great North Road
routes.sub: Stamford to Middlesbrough along the A1 and A19, by Grantham, Newark, Doncaster, York and Northallerton

routes.name: Tadcaster route
routes.sub: Leeds to York by Garforth and Tadcaster, the direct line between the two cities
